thread:
jia (eng-infra): Quick thread — Q4 hosted GPU buy/lease mix proposal. I ran updated throughput sims with current traffic curves and a 25% holiday surge. Need final input for commit recommendations and timing.

omar (finance): Thanks. Do you have the baseline numbers (gpu-hours/week) and cost delta for buy vs 12-month lease? :money_with_wings:

jia (eng-infra): Baseline (current fleet + autoscale) = 18k GPU-hours/week steady. Peak (25% surge) -> ~22.5k GPU-hours/week. Simulation assumptions: 70% chat traffic (LLM-chat medium), 20% embeddings, 10% batch/rerank. Using H100-80GB equivalent for estimates.

kelly (eng-runtime): How are you mapping throughput to GPU-hours? We saw big variance with padding and KV cache hit rates.

jia (eng-infra): Agreed — used a workload-aware profile (90th perc seq len, prefix cache enabled). Per-GPU effective sustained tokens/sec ~120k for chat mix (batching tuned). Embedding jobs accounted separately via dedicated small GPU pool. Quick calc included below.

andre (sre): Also remember APAC region fleet has 4-week lead for new nodes and some vendor minimums for racks. If we buy, shipping + rack config could be 10–12 weeks. Leasing spot/short term could be faster.

jia (eng-infra): Paste calc:```
Projected peak GPU-hours/week = peak_token_rate / (tokens_per_gpu_sec) * 3600 * 7 / 3600
Simplified: peak_token_rate (tokens/sec) / tokens_per_gpu_sec * 24 * 7 -> = GPU-count * 24 * 7
Estimated peak GPU count = 22.5k GPU-hours / 168hrs = ~134 GPUs (sustained) -> add 25% headroom for autoscale/spiky = ~168 GPUs
```

maria (product): That headroom seems reasonable for Q4 feature launches. Any thought on splitting buy vs lease by region? APAC capacity is the pain point.

omar (finance): Rough unit costs: buy amortized over 3y => $0.85 / GPU-hour. 12-month lease => $1.45 / GPU-hour. Short-term burst (on-demand/lease) => $2.10+/GPU-hour. Capex vs opex tradeoffs + procurement lead times.

kelly (eng-runtime): Also factor in increased ops cost for owning more hardware (SRE time, replacement spares). We estimated ~10% ops uplift if we increase owned fleet by >200 GPUs.

andre (sre): Networking note: if we place additional APAC gear in vendor colos we need to pre-book cross-connects — another 2–3 week lead. That pushes effective go-live.

jia (eng-infra): Proposed hybrid plan: - Buy 60% of required baseline (for NA/EU core) with H100s targeted for steady-state hour reduction. - Lease 40% as 12-month committed for APAC and burst pools. - Keep ~15% of peak as short-term on-demand leases for unexpected surge. Rationale: lowers long-run unit cost while keeping regional flexibility.

omar (finance): Ballpark budget ask for Q4 commit: buy ~120 GPUs (60% of projected steady), CAPEX ~$9.6M (includes racks, switches, kitting), plus leases ~$1.1M for 12-month commitments. Need formal quote to finalize.

maria (product): If we land this, we should lock routing policies so model fallbacks prefer cheaper variants before bursting to on-demand. Engineering + Product must coordinate the rollback profiles.

kelly (eng-runtime): Agree — will add a routing policy: prefer owned fleet -> 12mo leased -> on-demand. Also enable autoscale buffer thresholds and prefer KV cache warming during canaries.

andre (sre): Action item: I need a list of exact colo nodes/APAC sites to start cross-connect requests. Jia, can you add that to the procurement ticket?

jia (eng-infra): Will do. I'll open a procurement PR with exact SKU list and timeline, and ping @omar for approvals. Expected timelines in optimistic vs conservative mode: buy path = 10–12w, lease setup = 4–6w, on-demand = immediate.

capacity-bot: [capacity forecast update] New scenario (25% surge) simulated -> median P95 latency within SLO if hybrid plan executed by week 8.

omar (finance): OK, please attach the vendor quotes and the amortization schedule. Also include sensitivity to 40% surge just in case holiday spike is worse.

jia (eng-infra): Will attach. Quick sensitivity: 40% surge -> peak GPU-hours/week ~25.2k -> peak GPUs ~150 sustained -> headroom -> ~188 GPUs with 25% buffer. That increases short-term on-demand spend by ~$120k/month if unhedged.

maria (product): Sounds like we need an additional runbook for model degradation (knockdown lambda, shorter context) in case lease deliveries slip. Let's draft it while procurement proceeds.

kelly (eng-runtime): I'll start the routing + canary config and a small perf sweep on quantized variants to reduce per-GPU token cost.

andre (sre): I'll start cross-connect intake and check spare parts inventory.

omar (finance): Thanks everyone. Next steps: Jia opens procurement ticket + attaches quotes by EOD Wed. Finance will prep provisional PO. Product + Runtime to provide routing docs by next Tue. :thumbsup:
